title: This and Stranger Things s5 (white Meltie mug, new background, Netflix on the laptop)
notes: Exact replica of the Short with ONLY the background changed: a dark navy-blue wall with a night window and a warm fairy-light curtain replaces the red wall and the Christmas tree; desk, mug, laptop, props, hands, actions, framing and timing follow the original. WHITE variant of the real Meltie Mini Fondue Mug (store photo IMG_3998 + the white mug cropped from IMG-4087). The laptop is a green screen composited with the official Netflix logo (Netflix_2015_logo.svg from Wikimedia Commons, unchanged) filling the screen as on a real computer; the whole laptop is in frame in every shot ("screen.whole") so the full logo shows. Unbranded wafer wrapper; Sora audio. compare.trim ignores the worst-matching 35% of the picture (the new background).

product.name: Meltie Mug Mini Fondue Mug, white
product.description: the WHITE Meltie Mini Fondue Mug exactly as in the product photos: glossy off-white ceramic body that flares wider at the top, a dark chocolate-brown interior, 'Chocolate...' in brown cursive script with a small brown swirl/® mark on the front, a tall arched opening at the base for a tealight, an angular white handle on the right, and a fondue fork with a brown handle and long steel tines that clips into a slot in the handle

style: Vertical smartphone video filmed at night at a home desk, close camera at desk height; warm, cosy, slightly moody colour grade in a dim room with a dark navy-blue wall and warm fairy lights; hands have long light-grey manicured nails.
